name: GraceSl
body: My archive contains generated song drafts exported at different points over the past few months. A few titles appear on several exports, with filenames that do not explain the differences. My first step is preserving the originals and recording the purpose of every proposed revision. One search term in my notes is [url=https://repairsuno.top]remove suno artifacts[/url] but that label does not prove a revision improved the recording. Do you prefer folder separation, descriptive suffixes, or a simple spreadsheet for version tracking? I also need a way to distinguish a format conversion from a change made to the audio itself. For each file I can record the export date, source version, format, and reason for keeping it. I would rather maintain a small useful record than a complicated system I stop updating. Please share a naming example that would still make sense when reopening the folder next year.
